scientific_integrity: The complete finite simplicial collapse, residual triangulation, octahedral link and ball shelling are reconstructed and checked from a self-contained certificate by standard-library Python; independent mathematical assessment has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The simple-homotopy theorem applies to the standard Euclidean type-D4 root configuration at inclusive radius two, with no equivariance or optimality assertion. The previously published 24-cell integral Betti numbers and barcodes are not claimed as new.
title: A 736-collapse three-sphere core for the 24-cell Vietoris–Rips complex
